school_grammar_bunpou.origin: Hashimoto Shinkichi (橋本文法 / 学校文法)
principles: Classification into 6 Katsuyou stems (未然, 連用, 終止, 連体, 仮定, 命令)
Dichotomy between Jiritsugo (independent words) and Fuzokugo (attached clitic particles/auxiliaries)
Bunsetsu as the atomic communicative phrase unit

linguistic_frameworks.topic_grammar_mikami: Akira Mikami's 'The Subject Does Not Exist' (主語抹殺論) theory establishing 'は' as discourse anchor and relegating 'が' to clause-internal case.
linguistic_frameworks.functional_syntax_kuno: Susumu Kuno's discourse information packaging: Old information (は) vs Exhaustive new focus (が).
linguistic_frameworks.generative_syntax: Scrambling as non-operator movement (Saito, Kuroda), pro-drop parametric settings.

universal_dependencies_japanese.standard: UD_Japanese format mapping Kakariuke to head-final syntactic dependencies (nsubj, obj, obl, compound, mark, aux, punct).
